ConfigInvalid.fix_hint: Fix the check.toml field or packaged jev.toml entry (missing model), then retry.

CredentialStoreInvalid.fix_hint: the repo-root .env file (cause: permission denied). Make the file readable and retry.

EncodeFailed.fix_hint: response JSON could not be encoded as JSON (unexpected end of input error at line 1 column 1). Retry; if it persists, report it as a bug.

ExtractionEmpty.fix_hint: Change the query or input so extraction emits at least one subject.

ExtractionFailed.fix_hint: Fix the producer failure (exit 1) and run extraction again.

ExtractionInvalid.fix_hint: Emit a valid sc/subjects/1 document on stdout (schema) and retry.

ExtractionParseError.fix_hint: Fix the syntax error at a.py:3 and run extraction again.

ExtractionTimeout.fix_hint: Raise timeout_seconds above 30 or reduce the input so extraction finishes in time.

GitTimeout.fix_hint: git did not finish within 60s. Check for a stalled git process, a lock file (such as .git/index.lock) or a slow filesystem, then retry.

InputEmpty.fix_hint: Provide a non-empty input and retry.

InputInvalid.fix_hint: Correct the input so it matches the expected schema (bad json), then retry.

InputMissing.fix_hint: Create gone.toml or correct the path in check.toml, then retry.

InputTooLarge.fix_hint: Shrink the check input from 11 bytes to at most 10 bytes. One check is one request and is never split.

IoFailed.fix_hint: stdout I/O failed (cause: broken pipe). Check that it is readable or writable and retry.

KeyMissing.fix_hint: Provide a credential for typesafe via the process environment, the repo-root .env file, or the keyring, then retry.

LanguageUnavailable.fix_hint: Use a language built into sc-treesitter instead of cobol.

NetworkError.fix_hint: Check connectivity and retry. Transport detail: Jev HTTP 500. Backends retry busy responses before returning this error.

Operational.Io.fix_hint: stdout write failed. Check that stdout is writable.

PromptFileMissing.fix_hint: Provide the LLM system prompt at prompt.md, or select it with check.toml or the CLI override.

QueryInvalid.fix_hint: Fix the tree-sitter query syntax (syntax) and retry.

QueryNotFound.fix_hint: Choose a query asset that exists for this language instead of missing.

RegistryInvalid.fix_hint: Backend jev is not registered. Register it before the run.

ResponseInvalid.fix_hint: Retry the request. The judge response was invalid (truncated). If it persists, treat a truncated or off-schema response as a backend failure.

SessionDocumentInvalid.fix_hint: Session file s is not a session document. Delete it and start a new session.

SessionExpired.fix_hint: Start a new session. Session 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 expired; expiry is measured from the session created_at timestamp.

SessionNotFound.fix_hint: Create a session or pass the id of a session that still exists. Missing session: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

SessionStoreIo.fix_hint: Create session directory sessions failed (cause: permission denied). Choose a writable directory, then retry.
